intent_en: To illustrate the historical improvement and progression of 100m freestyle swimming times across 116 years of Olympic history.
previous_intent: To illustrate the historical improvement in Olympic freestyle swimming performance across Games from 1896 to 2012.
narration_support: What if we were swimming not just against the other swimmers in London, but against every Olympic medalist ever in a 100 meter freestyle? Here we're gliding over 116 years of Olympic history.
chart_support: Timeline chart (scatter plot with icons) displaying a downward trend of data points from 1896 to 2012, indicating decreasing times (improvement) over successive Olympic Games.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly mentions comparing against every medalist in a 100m freestyle over 116 years. The chart visualizes this with an x-axis of Olympic years (1896-2012) and a downward curve of data points, representing the reduction in race times (improvement in performance) over that period.
